hwang_abstract_epmc: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effectiveness of FA dCBT-I across 29 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) involving 9475 participants. Compared to control groups, FA dCBT-I demonstrated moderate to large effects on insomnia severity. Subgroup analyses indicated that FA dCBT-I had a significant impact when contrasted with most control groups but was less effective than therapist-assisted CBT-I.
